records.issue_text: findFirst-then-update/create in app-credential.ts is a check-then-act race that can create duplicate credentials under concurrent webhook deliveries; use a unique constraint on (userId, appId) plus upsert or a transaction
records.rationale: In apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts, the handler does `prisma.credential.findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` and then conditionally `update` else `create`. Under concurrent webhook deliveries for the same (userId, appId), both requests can observe no existing credential and both execute `create`, producing duplicate rows unless a unique constraint exists (not shown in this diff).
